description: Production-scale synthetic dataset and feature weights for training, regex validation, and client-side scoring in Next.js/Chrome extensions.
organization_notes: Development and QA dataset; not automatically loaded as extension detection rules.
Latest annotations are used for duplicate message text. Original documents are preserved in data/archive/fiverr-dataset-source-versions.json.
Older wording variants are retained as msg_101 and msg_102 with source references.
Risk labels and scores are preserved as supplied; they are not converted to detector thresholds.
Rule suggestions are merged by ID, retaining unique keywords; latest weights take precedence.
